item.title: Local rider earns championship at 2025 National Hare and Hound while spreading the Gospel
item.description: FERRON — Lucas Haberstich, a 22-year-old resident from Ferron, recently took home the Class C Championship for this year’s National Hare and Hound season. item.title: Emery swimmers earn the win at the Aquatic Center
item.description: CASTLE DALE – Swimmers from Emery, Carbon and Union came together at the Emery County Aquatic Center for a competitive tri-dual, with the hometown Spartans delivering a dominant performance to claim first place. Emery finished the meet with 444 total points, outpacing Union (364) and Carbon (272). Emery’s depth and balance were on full display throughout the meet.
